design.hyperparameter_selection: Fixed a priori; no tuning or final-model selection on outer test folds
design.interaction_ablation: Each interaction separately on top of C; unsupported folds omit it; no automatic pairwise interactions
design.interpretation: Descriptive paired CV and negative controls, no formal randomization p-value or causal/tactical identification
design.learning_subset: Nested source-group subsets selected without targets; all related occurrences retained
design.manual_weather: Sunny Day/Rain Dance observations flag unknown setter status if no supported ability option; their effects are not re-established from new sources
design.natural_speed_form: Pinned pre-Mega/base or explicitly observed non-Mega form; never assume Mega selected
design.own_features: Training vocabulary binary canonical moves plus one-hot original held item; no target nature, SP, calculated stats, cluster label or species/team one-hot
design.permutation_unit: Whole independent training-group blocks, permuted only among equal block sizes; no test donor and no independent record-level scrambling
design.population: 197 original complete M3.5.1 Incineroar occurrences; no no-SP applications
design.prediction_domain: Clip independent Speed/Attack predictions to [0,32], Bulk to [0,66]; never construct a joint SP build
design.priority_support_ability: Observed compatible Prankster with observed Status move of native priority >=0; capability only, no activation/target claim
design.source_groups: Preserve 192 M3.5.1 IDs and use 187 stronger M3.5.3 connected source groups for validation
design.unknown_policy: Explicit null; training-only median imputation, zero fallback for all-missing training columns, explicit missingness indicators; positive presence can be confirmed despite other unknown teammates
design.weather_pair: Observed speed ability and compatible distinct teammate setter option; two required Mega activations yield unknown, never asserted synergy
design.weather_setters: Compatible observed Drought/Drizzle, plus a fixed native Drought/Drizzle Mega option supported by an observed compatible required stone; Mega alternatives remain conditional
